De 5 Stjerner ApS is looking for several hands-on Housekeeping Managers and Supervisors to join our hotel cleaning operations in Aarhus.

Do you have experience in hotel housekeeping and enjoy leading a team? Are you organised, reliable and committed to delivering high cleaning standards? We would like to hear from you.

We have multiple positions available, with responsibilities adapted to your experience and the requirements of each hotel. We welcome applications from experienced housekeeping managers, supervisors and housekeeping professionals ready to take the next step into a leadership role.

About the roles

You will help coordinate daily housekeeping operations, support your team and ensure that guest rooms and public areas meet the hotel’s standards.

Working closely with hotel contacts and D5S operations management, you will organise tasks, monitor quality and follow up on room readiness. These are practical leadership roles where you will also assist with cleaning when needed.

Your responsibilities

• 
Plan and distribute daily cleaning tasks according to occupancy, departures and hotel priorities.

• 
Lead, motivate and support the housekeeping team throughout each shift.

• 
Inspect guest rooms, bathrooms and public areas to ensure consistent cleaning quality.

• 
Monitor progress and help ensure rooms are ready within agreed deadlines.

• 
Introduce and train new employees in cleaning procedures, equipment use and hotel standards.

• 
Communicate with hotel reception and management about room readiness, special requests and operational changes.

• 
Follow up on cleaning issues and ensure corrections are completed promptly.

• 
Monitor cleaning supplies, equipment and linen requirements.

• 
Report maintenance issues, damage and lost property according to hotel procedures.

• 
Ensure that hygiene and workplace safety procedures are followed.

• 
Assist with cleaning when necessary to support the team.

Who we are looking for

You should have experience in hotel housekeeping and understand the importance of both quality and efficient daily operations.

We are looking for colleagues who:

• 
Have supervisory or management experience, or strong housekeeping experience and the motivation to take on more responsibility.

• 
Can organise workloads and communicate clear priorities.

• 
Lead by example and treat colleagues with fairness and respect.

• 
Have a strong eye for detail and take pride in their work.

• 
Remain calm and solution-oriented during busy periods.

• 
Are dependable, punctual and comfortable taking responsibility.

• 
Can communicate effectively in English; Danish is an advantage.

• 
Are available to work weekends and public holidays as required by hotel operations.

What we offer

• 
Multiple opportunities within our hotel housekeeping operations in Aarhus.

• 
Responsibilities suited to your experience and the assigned hotel.

• 
An introduction to the workplace, procedures and quality standards.

• 
Support and cooperation from D5S operations management.

• 
The opportunity to develop your leadership skills and contribute to a well-organised team.

• 
Salary and employment conditions in accordance with the applicable collective agreement.

• 
Working hours and start date by agreement.

Benefits & development

What you can look forward to

💝

A GOOD START

Get introduced to your tasks, equipment and working routines, with guidance to help you feel confident from the beginning.

📚

OPPORTUNITES TO LEARN

Build your skills through relevant training and learning opportunities. Depending on your role and eligibility, this may include professional cleaning courses and Danish language classes.

✈️

ROOM TO GROW

Develop your experience and take on new responsibilities. As opportunities arise, your next step could be a supervisor or operations role.

📒

WORK ALONGSIDE YOUR STUDIES

Explore roles with flexible shifts that can fit around your studies. Availability and working hours depend on the position and location.

Do you enjoy practical work, notice the small details, and take pride in a job well done? We are looking for cleaning assistants to join our housekeeping team at CABINN Aarhus.

Whether you already have housekeeping experience or are ready to learn, we would love to hear from you. If you currently work at the hotel and would like to join De 5 Stjerner, you are also very welcome to apply.

Who are we?

De 5 Stjerner provides professional hotel housekeeping, commercial cleaning, and facility services across Denmark. Our people come from many different backgrounds, and together we help create clean, welcoming spaces for guests and customers every day.

Good housekeeping starts with a team that receives clear instructions, practical training, and support from its managers. We value teamwork, reliability, and pride in the work we do.

Your role

As a cleaning assistant, you will help ensure that hotel rooms and assigned areas are clean, comfortable, and ready for guests. Your daily tasks will include:

• 
Cleaning guest rooms, bathrooms, and assigned common areas.

• 
Making beds and changing bed linen and towels.

• 
Dusting, vacuuming, and washing floors.

• 
Replenishing guest supplies according to hotel standards.

• 
Emptying bins and handling waste correctly.

• 
Preparing and keeping your cleaning trolley and equipment organised.

• 
Reporting damage, maintenance issues, and lost property to your supervisor.

• 
Following cleaning procedures, hygiene standards, and safety instructions.

• 
Working with your colleagues to complete daily assignments on time.

Who are we looking for?

You do not need to know everything on your first day, but you should be willing to learn and take responsibility for your work.

We are looking for someone who:

• 
Is reliable, punctual, and ready to contribute to the team.

• 
Has an eye for detail and cares about cleanliness.

• 
Can work independently while cooperating with colleagues and supervisors.

• 
Is comfortable with an active job that involves standing, walking, bending, and repetitive tasks.

• 
Can follow instructions and maintain quality during busy days.

• 
Can communicate in English or Danish.

• 
Is available for shifts according to the hotel’s needs, including weekends and public holidays.

• 
Has the right to work in Denmark.

Previous experience in hotel housekeeping or professional cleaning is an advantage, but we also welcome motivated applicants who are ready to learn.

Contract and salary

• 
Workplace: CABINN Aarhus.

• 
Employment: Part-time, with a starting contract of 60 hours per month.

• 
Salary: In accordance with the applicable collective agreement.

• 
Working hours: Scheduled according to hotel operations and occupancy, including weekday and weekend shifts.

• 
Start date: By agreement.

De 5 Stjerner is looking for a reliable and experienced Cleaning Assistant to join our team at a hotel in Middelfart.

This is a part-time position combining linen handling and cleaning of public areas during evening and night shifts.

We are looking for someone who enjoys practical work, takes pride in maintaining high cleaning standards, and is comfortable working independently.

Your Responsibilities

• 
Transport clean and used linen between hotel floors and designated storage areas.

• 
Move and handle heavy linen trolleys.

•

•

• 
Ensure all assigned areas meet our quality and hygiene standards.

We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible!

If you meet the requirements and are interested in joining our team, please submit your application by clicking the "Apply" button.

Do you want to bridge the gap between a device and the customer using it? We are looking for an experienced Backend Software Engineer to help bring our IoT devices to life for construction customers: how they are configured, installed, verified and kept running. You join the Device Management team, work side by side with our firmware and hardware teams, and your work shows up in the telematics devices out in the field.

Bring our devices to life for customers. Your work covers the device lifecycle as well as building the internal tools our hardware and firmware teams use to debug them. It applies to new and existing devices, our own and third-party ones. You will build the backend that enables our devices' configuration, with AI as the core of how you develop.

**What's in it for you?

**

• See your impact. Your work shapes how devices reach the construction industry and how quickly customers can use them.

• Work close to the hardware. You design with the firmware team, whose building blocks you combine like Lego into new device configurations.

• Learn from experienced colleagues. You join a team with people who have 20+ years of experience and who are first movers on technology and AI.

• Work with AI every day. The team develops with Claude Code and Cursor, and you can contribute within your first weeks.

• Freedom and responsibility. The team has a lot of both, with an open door whenever you need input.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend engineer who cares that what you build works for the people using it, finds the way to the goal yourself, and knows which people to ask along the way.

• Solid hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot and GraphQL, including designing APIs and databases and the services around them.

• You are results-driven and self-driven: you unblock yourself, reach out to the right people early and follow your work through to delivery.

• You like to learn from the team and bring others along, and you can design a solution end to end, from database to service, and explain your choices to colleagues in firmware and across engineering.

• Domain knowledge can be learned. An IoT background, such as an understanding of protocols, is a plus, but we value learning speed more.

• Nice to have: Postgres (or another relational database), Kafka or other messaging, Cassandra, GitHub, and experience working with MCP tooling.

AI is the core of how our team builds software, including a shared AI development workflow. We expect you to use AI as your main development platform, or to be keen to. Hands-on experience with AI-first development is a big plus.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Build new device configurations for our device administration tool, designed together with the firmware team, including bulk configuration updates for customers.

• Develop the backend behind them: API extensions, GraphQL, database design and orchestration, Java services and Kafka topics.

• Take features from the first idea to a device in the field, in close collaboration with our firmware and hardware teams.

• Support the rest of the device lifecycle, including installation, verification and the internal tool our hardware and firmware teams use to debug devices.

• Help the team grow: share what you know, review each other's work and raise the bar together.

****Our hiring process

****Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.

• A deeper conversation: We'll go into your experience and how you work, and you'll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role actually looks like day to day.

• Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.

• If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!

****Coming Together To Connect Construction

****We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products – it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

At Sumary, we are rebuilding finance from first principles. In short, we are creating the AI operating system for accounting work. Founded in 2025, Sumary is already used by some of the largest accounting firms in the world, including Deloitte, Grant Thornton and Baker Tilly, and the products we ship will define how finance teams work in the coming decade.

We have raised $29m, including the largest seed round ever in the Nordics, from Singular, byFounders, Partech and Tenity, and angels including Tuomas Artman (Linear), Morten Primdahl (Zendesk), Steve Anavi (Qonto), Stanislas Polu (Dust), Steffen Tjerrild (Synthesia), Jannick Malling (Public) and Ben Freeman (Omnea).

Our engineers are also our product managers and designers. You talk to customers, understand their pain points, design the best solution and ship it to a standard that sets the bar for the industry. You are confident owning features end to end, from the data model to the last pixel of the interface.

AI writes most of our code, so producing code is no longer the bottleneck. Judgment is: deciding what is worth building, and making it excellent. Just because something takes half a day to build doesn't mean it should exist.

We are a small team of full-stack generalists, TypeScript end to end, and product comes first in everything we build. What unites us is a deep care for craft, fast execution and the discipline to say no. We are looking for experienced engineers who thrive on autonomy and individual responsibility.

We have offices in Copenhagen and London. Copenhagen is our engineering hub, and this role is based there.

**Come help define and build the future of finance.

**What you'll do

• Work closely with founders and customers, and turn what you hear into the right solution, which is often not the one they asked for

• Build new user-facing features end to end, with beautiful and scalable UI components

• Obsessively improve performance, so every interaction feels instant, even for our largest accounting firms

• Use what you built the way a customer would, and polish it until it is right before it ships

• Delete by default: push back on scope, on features we shouldn't build and on anything that feels off

• When an agent gets something wrong, fix the tooling so it doesn't happen again for anyone

What we're looking for

• 5+ years building customer-facing products at a company known for the quality of its software

• Deep fluency in TypeScript and React, and confidence across the full stack: Node.js, Postgres and the data model underneath

• Product obsession and a good eye for design: you care about UX, speed and polish. You notice the slow interaction, the awkward empty state and the setting nobody needs, and you fix them without being asked

• A track record of shipping complete features end to end, not only incremental work

• Comfort working without a product manager. You would rather talk to the customer yourself

• High ownership: you take a problem from start to finish and care about how it lands

• You know the difference between extra effort and meaningful quality

• You build AI-first, directing agents through the implementation while you own the judgment

Nice to have

• Experience as one of the first engineers at a startup that went on to scale

• Interfaces you designed yourself, not only built

• Experience with financial and ledger data

Our stack

TypeScript end to end: React and Next.js, Node.js, Postgres and Supabase, Temporal, Modal and our AI service layers. We don't expect you to have used all of it.

Applying

Along with your CV, send us something you built that you are proud of, and one thing in a product you use every day that you would fix.

**Job Description

**HO Finance oversees accounting, tax, treasury, controlling and internal controls — driving value through financial stewardship, compliance, and forward-looking support. The role requires on top, a good understanding of the company's ERP and financial system interfaces, together with IFRS and Local Danish Gaap knowledge.

This person will be the backbone of Finance, making sure tight deadlines are met in a timely manner and in quality.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Be

**

• Lead a high performance multicultural accounting team consisting of Accounts receivable, Accounts payable, general ledger, controlling and customs.

• Ensure proper accounting, reporting and complete, timely and consistent financial accuracy of all records and assets.

• Provide management with periodic financial reports and analyses for management decision-making.

• Ensure an effective internal control environment.

• Support operations through responsibility of: accounting and financial reporting, month-end close, tax, internal controls, cash and debt management, working capital management, insurance, and risk management.

• Cooperation with external auditors for the annual reports in Satair DK and Satair UK incl. local tax computations and tax-reporting to authorities.

• Cooperation with internal auditors from Airbus Group.

Travel days to be expected are 2-4 yearly travels to Hamburg and Toulouse, 1-2 trips to UK as necessary.

**You will be required to apply business experience, judgement and compliance knowledge to provide added value for the business therefore we are looking for a person with a Masters degree or similar education with a minimum of 5 years at a middle or senior level in a financial management function, preferably in a global wholesale/distribution organization or audit.

Good analytical skills; ability to see the bigger picture and derive mid to long term recommendations on the way forward to stakeholders and excellent communication skills is a must. Teamplayer and the ability to balance and align varying interests of stakeholders is a key feature to master in this position.

A digital mindset, proficient in SAP or similar business management system and mastery of Google suite solutions and AI preferred.

As the company language is English, excellent command of both written and spoken English is a must.

**What does your next challenge look like?

**At SATAIR, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international and diverse teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow, making an impact on aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

_Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company!

**Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

With our global functional organisation spanning 12 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 2,000 people supporting a $3.9 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.

Welcome to the Satair family!

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

**What do we offer at SATAIR?

**At SATAIR, you will find much more than a job - we offer you the possibility of growing both your personal and professional capacities in a fun, supportive and informal working environment, where you will be encouraged to engage, share knowledge and ideas.

We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

We are looking for a Data Regulation Counsel to support Veo’s work within data protection and emerging technology regulation. You will play a key role in the day-to-day operation of Veo’s compliance framework and help ensure that our products, services, development, and internal processes meet applicable regulatory requirements.

You will join the Legal Team, currently consisting of four full-time employees, and work closely with it, as well as colleagues across IT, Marketing, Product, and other business areas. While the role's primary focus is GDPR compliance, your tasks will also include operational compliance related to NIS2, the Data Act, the Cyber Resilience Act, and the AI Act.

This is a unique opportunity to join a growing Legal function and help build scalable, pragmatic compliance processes at a company experiencing significant growth and continuous development.

**You can expect tasks within a variety of areas, including:

**

• Supporting the implementation and day-to-day operation of Veo’s data regulation compliance framework, ensuring that established processes are followed and continuously improved.

• Assisting in ensuring that Veo’s products, services, and internal data processing activities comply with applicable data regulation requirements.

• Providing practical and solution-oriented support to teams across Veo on data regulation matters, with a focus on translating legal requirements into operational processes.

• Drafting, updating, and maintaining relevant policies, procedures, and documentation, including privacy notices, records of processing activities, transfer impact assessments, incident response procedures, and documentation required under the regulatory frameworks.

• Supporting the handling of operational compliance tasks, including data subject rights requests, personal data breaches, and security incidents.

• Contributing to drafting and facilitating training and awareness initiatives.

• Supporting the management of third-party relationships from a compliance perspective, including assisting with due diligence, contractual requirements, and ongoing monitoring.

• Contributing to the ongoing monitoring, development, optimization, and, where relevant, automation of compliance processes, ensuring that Veo’s approach remains scalable and aligned with business needs.

Previous experience with all of the above is not required.

**Your qualifications:

**

• A master’s degree in law or business law from a Nordic university.

• Solid experience with advising on GDPR and/or other data regulation. Experience from scale ups or law firms is an advantage but not required..

• An interest in and basic understanding of broader technology regulation (e.g. NIS2, AI Act, Data Act).

• A pragmatic and structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to translate legal requirements into commercial and operational solutions.

• An interest in working closely with stakeholders across different functions and with varying professional backgrounds.

• A solid understanding of and interest in technology and artificial intelligence.

• The ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a dynamic environment.

• Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

At Veo, the Legal Team is part of the Finance Department, and you will report to the Head of Legal. In your day-to-day work, you will collaborate closely with our experienced Data Protection Counsel. We offer an informal working environment where individual contributions are highly valued, both professionally and socially. We encourage personal and professional development while providing a flexible work environment, even during busy periods.

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

Intro

Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you'll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people — sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You'll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

We're looking for a Solution Engineer who's ready to roll up their sleeves, take ownership, and build with us — through the grind and the wins. You'll be the technical partner to our Sales team: you work out what customers need, show them how Monta solves it, and make sure what we sell can be delivered.

This Is What You Will Achieve

• Win the technical decision — be the reason charge point operators, energy companies and fleet owners choose Monta to run their charging business.

• Make sure what we sell gets delivered — the commitments made during the sale are realistic and land cleanly with our implementation team.

• Shape the product — turn what you hear from customers into clear input that Product and Engineering can act on.

What You Will Do

• Lead technical discovery — understand the customer's business, their current charging setup (platform, hardware, roaming, billing) and what they need to integrate with.

• Run demos built around the customer — tailored to their use cases, not a feature tour.

• Design the solution — define the high-level architecture and integration approach, from OCPP chargers and OCPI roaming to APIs, ERP and energy management.

• Lead proofs of concept and technical evaluations — agree scope and success criteria up front and see them through to sign-off.

• Answer the hard questions — technical, architecture, integration and security questions in meetings, RFPs and security questionnaires.

• Spot risk early — flag gaps and dependencies before a deal is committed, and push back when a promise can't be kept.

• Partner with Sales — on the technical strategy for complex, multi-country deals.

• Hand over cleanly — give the Solution Architect a documented scope so implementation starts on solid ground.

• Close the loop with Product — feed recurring requirements and product gaps back to Product and Engineering.

• Help post-sales when it's busy — for example scoping a migration or running a technical workshop with a live customer.

What We're Looking For

• Experience in a customer-facing technical role — as a Solution Engineer, Sales Engineer or pre-sales consultant, selling B2B software or platform products.

• You explain technical topics clearly to non-technical people — and can go deep with the customer's engineers in the same meeting.

• Your discovery gets to the real problem — you ask the question behind the requirement before proposing a solution.

• You build demos that tell the customer's story — you're comfortable changing course live when the conversation goes somewhere new.

• Hands-on with APIs and integrations — you can read API docs, test calls yourself, and explain web-hooks, authentication and data flows.

• Commercial awareness — you understand how deals are won and lost, and you know when to protect scope.

• You write clearly — solution designs, RFP answers and handover notes that others can act on without a follow-up call.

• EV charging, energy or mobility knowledge is a plus (OCPP, OCPI, load management), but not required. We'll teach you the domain.

• You use AI to work faster — for example on RFP drafts, research, demo prep and documentation, and you check the output before it reaches a customer.

• Fluent English, and happy to travel to customer workshops around Europe from time to time.

**_If the mission excites you but your experience isn't a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway — we care about potential, not perfection.

Building AI keeps getting cheaper and faster. Deciding what's worth building, and getting an organisation to actually commit to it, does not.

Then you steer a strong engineering team to make it real - without being the one in the codebase.

This is the strategic counterpart to our engineers. Where they go deep into the build, you hold the commercial and strategic frame: what problem are we really solving, what impact are we creating, in what order, and how do we get the organisation to adopt it. You're more product manager than a traditional consultant, with a strong strategic angle - closer to an Engagement Manager who's technical enough to make the right calls than a slide-deck advisor.

You'll work closely with engineers, data specialists, strategists and designers in a company where ideas move quickly and the distance from thinking to building is intentionally small.

What you'll work on

• Owning client relationships at the leadership level - being the person the C-suite trusts

• Framing the real problem behind the ask, and shaping it into an engagement worth running together with our FDEs

• Sequencing what gets built, in what order, and being accountable for the business value - not just the artifact

• Steering engineering teams toward outcomes, translating in both directions between the client and the builders

• Driving adoption: managing expectations, working with the people who have to live with the solution, and staying through the part after launch

• Scoping, structuring and de-risking engagements as they evolve

• Spotting where the next opportunity sits inside an account and growing it

****You probably have experience with

**

• Management consulting, change management, adoption, implementation of AI-native solutions.

• Owning client or stakeholder relationships end to end, with real accountability for outcomes

• Being technically literate - fluent enough in data and AI to make the right calls and earn trust with both buyers and builders, without needing to write the production code yourself

• Translating between business strategy and what's actually buildable

• Bringing structure to ambiguous, fast-moving situations

• The patience to sit with a worried manager, and the stubbornness to stay until adoption actually lands

**

• people care deeply about what they build

• good ideas move quickly

• new technology gets explored early

We're around 50 people today after merging with Pyne, and we're only just getting started.

About MITS Industries

MITS Industries is establishing an R&D and design site in Copenhagen focused on advanced RF systems, signal intelligence, aerospace technologies, and mission-critical product development.

The site will build core engineering capabilities in RF and microwave hardware, antenna systems, RF testing and characterization, rugged mechanical integration, and the industrialization of complex radio-electronic systems.

The Copenhagen team will work closely with strategic partners and engineering teams across Europe, playing a leading role in the development, validation, and industrialization of advanced technologies for defense, aerospace, and other demanding applications.

One of the initial focus areas will be the development of an advanced aerospace signal intelligence product platform. The work will cover RF and system architecture, antenna system design, signal acquisition, embedded control, laboratory validation, mechanical integration, integration with the satellite platform, and preparation for production and field deployment.

The ambition is to build a strong technical design site capable of taking complex RF products, modules, and platforms from architecture and detailed design through prototyping, testing, validation, industrialization, and deployment.

About the role

MITS Industries is looking for a Senior Antenna Systems Engineer to join the core Copenhagen R&D team and help build the site’s antenna systems design capability.

You will design and develop antenna systems and subsystems for advanced aerospace and signal-intelligence applications. The work covers antenna-system architecture, performance analysis and design trade-offs, antenna elements and arrays, feed and matching networks, full-wave electromagnetic simulation, platform integration, prototyping, measurement, and performance validation. You will take antenna concepts through detailed design and implementation, including integration with RF hardware, mechanical structures, radomes, and satellite platforms.

You will work closely with system architects, RF and microwave hardware engineers, signal-processing engineers, RF test and characterization engineers, mechanical design engineers, and partner engineering teams. • Support antenna-system calibration and performance assessment for coherent, multichannel, or direction-finding applications.

• Contribute to environmental qualification, reliability assessment, tolerance analysis, manufacturability, supplier selection, and production release.
